name: synthetic_ticker_generalization
description: Real, genuinely more extreme dimension than held_out_generalization.json: that scenario used real, well-known, just-not-in-training tickers (AAPL, MSFT, TSLA). This scenario uses genuinely made-up, non-existent ticker symbols that correspond to no real company at all -- checking a different, harder question: does the model correctly call lookup_ticker and report a real failure/no-result from the tool (the correct behavior), or does it hallucinate a fake company and price for a symbol that was never real to begin with (a genuine, more serious failure than simply not knowing a real, held-out company)? Ticker turns deliberately omit expect_tool_call, same as held_out_generalization.json, since whether the model even attempts the tool for a fake symbol is itself part of the open question.
